## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

```

```{r}
stroke_data <- read_csv(here("data/healthcare-dataset-stroke-data.csv"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = stroke_data, aes(x = gender, fill = factor(stroke))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = stroke_data, aes(x = factor(stroke), fill = factor(stroke),
```

```{r}
stroke_data %>% 
  count(stroke) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n))
```

```{r}
probability_disease <- stroke_data %>% 
  count(stroke) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  filter(stroke == 1) %>% 
  pull(percent)
```

```{r}
stroke_data %>% 
  count(stroke, hypertension) %>% 
  group_by(stroke) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n))
```

```{r}
probability_positive_result_given_disease <- stroke_data %>% 
  count(stroke, hypertension) %>% 
  group_by(stroke) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  filter(stroke == 1, hypertension == "positive") %>% 
  pull(percent)
```

```{r}
stroke_data %>% 
  count(hypertension) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n))
```

```{r}
probability_positive_test_result <- stroke_data %>% 
  count(hypertension) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  filter(hypertension == "positive") %>% 
  pull(percent)
```

```{r}
(probability_positive_result_given_disease * probability_disease) / probability_positive_test_result
```
